sections.title: Withholding tax (staðgreiðsla): three steps, per month

rows.label: Step 1 (skattþrep 1): 16.55% income tax + 14.94% average municipal tax
Step 2 (skattþrep 2): 23.05% income tax + 14.94% average municipal tax
Step 3 (skattþrep 3): 31.35% income tax + 14.94% average municipal tax

source.title: Skatturinn: Staðgreiðsla 2026 (Hlutföll og fjárhæðir); Fjármála- og efnahagsráðuneytið: Breytingar á staðgreiðslu um áramótin (22 December 2025)

sections.basis: Monthly pay after the employee's pension contributions, per month
sections.note: Each step's rate applies to the part of the month's pay inside the step. The combined rate is the state income tax (tekjuskattur) plus the average municipal tax (útsvar) of 14.94%, which is used in withholding everywhere; the municipality's own rate is settled in the annual assessment. The personal tax credit is deducted from the tax calculated.

rows.value: People working in their own business must pay themselves a calculated wage, at least what they would earn doing the same work for an unrelated employer and not below the tax authority's minimum for their category; it is taxed like wages, with withholding tax, tryggingagjald and pension contributions
